'''Corn chowder''' is a [[chowder]] soup prepared using [[Maize|corn]] as a primary ingredient. Basic corn chowder is commonly made of corn, onion, celery, milk or cream, and butter. Additional ingredients sometimes used include potatoes or squash, salt pork, fish, seafood and chicken. In the United States, recipes for corn chowder date to at least as early as 1884. Corn chowder is [[Mass production|mass-produced]] as a [[Canning|canned]] food in the U.S.
